survivingClaim: For any finitely supported mu' on [1, D] and X >= D: sum_m (1*mu')(m) m^-1/2 R(X/m) = -(4 + 2 gamma) sqrt X M'(1) - zeta'(1/2) M'(1/2) + E, |E| <= ||mu'||_1 (6 + log X)/sqrt X. With mu' = mu_{<=U} - c2 delta_2 - c3 delta_3 and M'(1) = M'(1/2) = 0: R(X) = K'_X[R] + Xi', |Xi'| <= (U + 32 sqrt U + 25)(6 + log X)/sqrt X, unconditional (7.99e-7 at X = 1e32). The Vaughan X^{1/4} forcing is a normalisation. The kernel symbol is 1 at every zero on or off the line; kernel absolute mass is of order sqrt X. A one-sided polylog bound on K'[R] is equivalent to RH. NOT surviving: the parity cap at restricted level (false: restricted-level Legendre plus positivity is the half-weight Chebyshev/Legendre LP, whose polylog gap is an open RH-hard quantity).
obstruction: After the forcing is removed by two linear conditions on the mollifier, every identity of this shape is a linear combination of the half-weight Legendre identity (1*Lambda = log) with symbol exactly 1 at every zero; at full level Lambda >= 0 is implied (system has the single solution Lambda), and the remaining one-sided polylog bound on K'[R] is equivalent to RH (Theorem OS). Positivity enters only in Landau's lemma.
controlsThatDefeat: E_a = zeta(s+a)zeta(s-a): not excluded by any proved step
structured sign twist with Lambda >= 0 (TW+): not excluded by any proved step
lesson: Filter out any combination whose only new ingredient is a different Type-I/Type-II split or mollifier of this shape; a live route must use positivity non-linearly or the size normalisation that separates zeta from E_a. Restricted-level Legendre plus positivity is NOT closed by parity: it is the Legendre LP lane.
refereeNote: Verdict stands. Theorem R(iii) (parity cap at restricted level, labelled PROVED) is false: Theorem P does not apply to Chebyshev-class weights. Also not surviving: uniqueness of the dual certificate, '5-8x', 'X^0.44', '4.7e-7 by proof'.

newNodes.statement: The X^{1/4} Vaughan forcing equals -(4+2gamma) sqrt X M'(1) - zeta'(1/2) M'(1/2) and is removed by two linear conditions on the mollifier; residual |Xi'| <= (U + 32 sqrt U + 25)(6 + log X)/sqrt X.
